name: Fighter Strategic Soldier
body:
A strategic soldier is a master of positioning and teamwork in combat.

Flanker (Ex)

At 1st level, a strategic soldier may designate any square adjacent to them as the square they are occupying for the purposes of gaining and granting flanking bonuses. The strategic soldier may declare this square as a free action once per round. The next change in the same round is a swift action.

This ability replaces the bonus combat feat gained at 1st level.

Sidestep (Ex)

At 2nd level, a strategic soldier gains Sidestep as a bonus feat without needing to meet the prerequisites.

This ability replaces all instances of bravery.

Interpose (Ex)

At 3rd level, a strategic soldier can take the damage dealt by an attack to an ally if they are adjacent to the attacker. The strategic soldier takes the damage and other effects of the attack as if they were the initial target.

This ability is usable once per day at 3rd level, and an additional time per day for each 3 levels thereafter.

This ability replaces the armor training gained at 3rd level.

Defending Allies (Ex)

Starting at 7th level, anytime a strategic soldier uses fighting defensively, full defense, or Combat Expertise, they can provide the AC bonus to up to two adjacent allies. The allies don’t take the penalties to attack, but the strategic soldier does.

This ability replaces the armor training gained at 7th level.

Reckless Strike (Ex)

Starting with 11th level, a strategic soldier can eschew defense to make more dangerous strikes. They gain a +5 bonus to attack and damage rolls for 1 round. However, during the round, any attacks that hit them are considered critical threats.

This ability replaces the armor training gained at 11th level.

Knock Off-kilter (Ex)

Starting at 15th level, a strategic soldier can make a single attack as a full-round action. If the attack hits, the target provokes attacks of opportunity from any ally threatening the target with a weapon capable of performing attacks of opportunity.

You can apply Vital Strike and similar feats to this attack.

This ability is not usable on creatures more than one size category larger than the strategic soldier.

This ability replaces the armor training gained at 15th level.

Punishing Strike (Ex)

Starting with 19th level, a strategic soldier can make an attack of opportunity against a foe that deals damage to an ally. They must be able to hit the attacker and perform attacks of opportunity with their equipped weapon to trigger this ability.

This ability replaces armor mastery.
